observations: Close-up of a tire tread with a manufacturer's sticker attached.
Sticker identifies the brand as Michelin and the model as Pilot Sport 4 SUV.
Sticker lists the size as 255/50R20 and load/speed rating as 109Y.
The tread appears deep and unused, though the sticker is worn and partially peeled.
Watermarks indicate the seller is 'FRANCOBEST ENT' or 'FRANCO GLOBAL ENTERPRISES'.

risks.risk: The tire may be 'New Old Stock' (expired or near-expiry rubber).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code (4 digits in an oval) on the sidewall.

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage or previous repairs (plugs/patches).
risks.proof: Photos of both the inner and outer sidewalls and the interior casing.

risks.risk: The sticker may not match the tire (mismatched or reapplied).
risks.proof: Photo of the size and model name molded into the tire sidewall rubber.
risks.if_unproven: as the model shown on the sticker

proof_requests: Photo of the 4-digit DOT date code on the sidewall.
Photos of the full inner and outer sidewalls showing the molded specifications.
Photo of the inside of the tire to check for patches.
response.reason: The tire is clearly identified by the manufacturer sticker as a Michelin Pilot Sport 4 SUV in size 255/50R20. It can be priced as a single unit at the worst-case value for unverified age.
